name: Burak Yilmaz
bio:
Burak Yilmaz's journey into motorsport security was somewhat accidental, stemming from his background in electronics and a keen eye for detail honed during his mandatory military service. He began as a junior technician for a local karting team, quickly rising through the ranks thanks to his methodical approach and unwavering commitment to safety. His dedication caught the attention of CLRT by Almeras, who headhunted him to revamp their security protocols.

Burak's philosophy is simple: prevention is paramount. He meticulously analyzes potential vulnerabilities, implementing proactive measures to safeguard the team's assets and personnel. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to quickly assess and neutralize threats. His goal is not just to meet minimum standards, but to set a new benchmark for security in motorsport, making CLRT by Almeras a fortress of safety and integrity.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave on top.
physical.description: Burak is of average height with a lean build, often seen with a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small multi-tool, even in meetings.
Insists on checking every lock and seal at least twice.
Has a habit of speaking in acronyms related to security protocols.
